name: Internship / New Grad
aiPrompt: Draw on coursework, projects, internships and activities from my resume. Keep the tone enthusiastic and humble, and never claim experience I do not have.
blocks: I am writing to apply for the {{JOB_TITLE}} position at {{COMPANY_NAME}}. As someone at the start of my career, I am looking for a team where I can learn quickly and contribute real work from the first week.
I would be grateful for the chance to talk with you about the role and about what I could learn and contribute at {{COMPANY_NAME}}.
